name: Xun Hui Long Niao - Find The Cage Bird
original_name: 寻回笼鸟 - Find The Cage Bird
source:
The descendant of the ancient white dragon wakes up in a foreign land, and embarks on a journey of witness that belongs to him—

[From [url=https://srinya.itch.io/ftcb]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
远古白龙的传人在异乡苏醒，踏上了属于他的见证之旅——

[来自[url=https://srinya.itch.io/ftcb]Itch.io[/url]]
